title: Nova Scotia Health: reported expenses and their budget basis

source.title: Nova Scotia Health Consolidated Financial Statements, March 31, 2026
source.attribution: Source: Nova Scotia Health, consolidated financial statements; amounts independently re-expressed from stated tables.

accountingContext.reportingEntity: Nova Scotia Health Authority including the Provincial Drug Distribution Program (PDDP)
accountingContext.basis: Canadian public sector accounting standards; recognized expenses are not a vendor payment ledger
accountingContext.budgetBasis: Note 24 describes the Department of Health and Wellness-approved NS Health budget, adds PDDP and presentation adjustments to align with current-year consolidated results. No separate approval instrument or approval date is established here.
accountingContext.comparativeBasis: Note 25 says some prior-year figures were reclassified to the current presentation. These are the 2025 comparative values in the 2026 statement, not a claim of unrevised original reporting.

limitations: Service and object expenses are alternative classifications of the same totals; never add the two tables or their totals together.
The budget bridge is a basis reconciliation, not a second source of expenditure or proof of legal appropriation.
Actual-minus-budget differences alone do not establish illegality, inefficiency, unpaid bills, or missing cash.
No vendor, tender, invoice, ambulance-contract payment, patient or service-outcome linkage is established.
NS Health/PDDP consolidated scope is not all provincial health spending and is not a combined NS Health/IWK account.
Compensation is an institutional aggregate; individual salaries and PDF contact/signature metadata are not projected.
Historical statements do not establish current performance or source freshness beyond the retained retrieval.
nextRecords: Approved budget instrument and subsequent amendments, with dates and defined accounting perimeter.
Documented management explanations for service-category variances and their corresponding program delivery records.
Contract/invoice/payment records with exact identifiers before linking aggregate contracted services to suppliers.
rightsScope: Candidate projection is numerical facts, institution/category labels, precise source locators and independently written context only; no report facsimile, logos, signatures, personal contact details or extended narrative. Not a blanket licence for source reproduction.
